decision: Leave D. E. Shaw & Co. and found his own company

claim_ref: N11; K01 | AUDIT 3 (MEDIUM) basis fix: this row said '~26-week trading year' while stage_1.md R said 'about 5.5 months' for the same quantity, and quantitative.csv carried 5.5 against its own stated 1995-07-01 to 1995-12-31 span, which is 184 days = 6.0 months. decision: Consent to terminate the Subchapter S election and become a Subchapter C taxpayer

decision: Build the offer on per-order distributor purchasing instead of holding inventory

decision: Announce the store publicly as 'World's Largest Bookseller' with more than one million titles advertised
